records.analysis_current_design: [Fix] api: Fix `return_hidden_states` on `/generate`（Fixes #50879、#51470）。一次修三个问题：① `"last"` 自 v0.5.22 起返回 400——api.v1 schema 把该字段声明为 `BoolOrList`，契约检查因此拒绝字符串；② 响应形状不对；③ 单 prompt 时返回该是 list 而不是裸张量。这是**公共接口层**的回归修复，直接决定 RL 侧还能不能按文档取到 last hidden。
records.npu: 需实测：Ascend 走同一 `/generate` 与 tokenizer 契约检查，修复后需要复核 `"last"` 在 NPU 上返回的形状与 dtype 一致。

records.title: [Bug] /generate rejects "return_hidden_states": "last" since 0.5.22 (0.5.21 accepted it)

events.body:
Update with two results I didn't have when I filed this. The scope hasn't changed: `true` and `false` stay valid with the same meaning, and the fix adds `"last"` as a third value. I haven't opened a PR.

**Design A against a live gRPC server**

The A/B table above came from an offline round trip. I've now run A live. Server: the Rust frontend built with design A, started with `--grpc-port`. Client: built from main's proto (`2a71304ac5`, field 10 is `BoolOrList`).

| Client built from main's proto sends | Result |
|---|---|
| field not set | OK |
| `false` | `INTERNAL` |
| `true` | `INTERNAL` |
| `[true]` | `INTERNAL` |

Error for `false` and `true` (`[true]` fails with a different decode message):

```
INTERNAL: failed to decode Protobuf message: ReturnHiddenStatesOrList.value: GenerateRequest.return_hidden_states: invalid wire type: Varint (expected LengthDelimited)
```

The result is t…

records.analysis_current_design: [Bug] `/generate` 自 **0.5.22** 起拒绝 `return_hidden_states: "last"`（0.5.21 可用）。这是版本级回归的明确证据：同一个字段在 0.5.21 与 0.5.22 之间从「接受字符串」变成「只接受 bool/list」。对下游是静默破坏——调用方不改代码就 400。
records.npu: 缺失：版本回归同样影响 Ascend 用户（同一 schema）；升级到 0.5.22+ 后需要该修复才能用 `"last"`。

records.title: [Fix] glm5_next: Gather DFlash aux hidden states for every scattered MoE all-to-all backend

events.body:
> Thanks for the PR and the detailed validation results! One concern:
> 
> 1. **Aux capture gathers already complete rows on UNPADDED batches** ([code](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/00fcb858a322981eadbc5703dd07d24aafcea180/python/sglang/srt/models/glm5_next.py#L1109)). With megamoe, attention DP disabled, `--disable-attn-tp-gather`, and eager DFLASH with block size 5, each attention-TP rank already holds the complete rows. The new gate gathers them again, and the verify reshape folds the duplicated rows into the feature dimension. I reproduced this with real CUDA/NCCL on 4×H100 using a nine-layer pretrained-weight fixture: the base generates 16 tokens, while this PR fails with `Expected shape [N, 20480], got shape=(5, 81920)`. Please decide whether to gather from the actual batch capture layout and add regression coverage for indivisible token counts.

@Wangyuaneee123 Th…
